description: This file defines the 'Image_Canvas_GD_PNG' class which extends 'Image_Canvas_GD' to handle PNG image creation, rendering, and saving functionalities within the Image_Canvas package. The class manages PNG-specific image output and transparency settings.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_GD_PNG
classes.description: A class to handle PNG image creation, transparency, display, and saving, extending the general GD canvas class.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_GD_PNG
methods.description: Constructor that initializes PNG canvas with optional transparency settings.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the PNG image to the browser with appropriate headers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the PNG image to a specified file.
